subject: MSA / audit ops: aligning SOC 2 boundary, pen-test windows, and evidence rhythm
messages:
From: Avery Ross <avery.ross@pulselabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: PulseLabs Security Team <security@pulselabs.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA / audit scope questions — SOC 2 boundary + pen test cadence

Hi Kimberly / Laura,

Sorry to kick off the long weekend thread — wanted to get ahead of contract language ahead of our procurement milestone. We reviewed the MSA + proposed Order Form and have three quick ask areas we need clarity on before we push the PO: 

1) SOC 2 boundary: can you confirm which Redwood product surfaces will be in-scope for the SOC 2 report (hosted API only, or Dedicated/Private options as well)? We need to align our SOC 2 vendor attestation mapping.

2) Pen test window and blast radius: PulseLabs requires a 30-day notice window for full-scope pen tests and a staging-only window for high-risk testing. Can you confirm your pen-test notice expectations and whether Redwood will provide ephemeral staging creds?

3) Evidence cadence & delivery: for initial onboarding we ask for artifacts (SOC 2 report, pen-test summary, remediation timeline) and 8 weeks of evidence exports. What cadence do you propose for evidence handoffs and what delivery mechanism is supported (secure Drive link, SFTP, or portal upload)?

I've attached our security questionnaire (PulseLabs_Security_Questionnaire.pdf) — we highlighted the assurance bits. If helpful, happy to do a quick 30-min sync early next week. Our procurement target is to have the Order Form executed by 2026-09-10, so we're on a bit of a timeline.

Thanks,
Avery Ross
Sr. Procurement Manager, PulseLabs
avery.ross@pulselabs.com

Attachment: PulseLabs_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Ross <avery.ross@pulselabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / audit scope questions — SOC 2 boundary + pen test cadence

Hi Avery — thanks for the clear list. Appreciate the timeline; we should be able to meet your procurement target with a short cadence. High level answers below and a proposed ops playbook attached (MSA_Security_Exhibit_DRAFT.docx) — please put redlines directly into the doc and we'll consolidate.

1) SOC 2 boundary: Redwood's SOC 2 covers the Hosted API (our multi-tenant hosted environment) by default. Dedicated and Private (VPC/on-prem) are out of scope for the standard report unless the customer elects Dedicated-specific attestation; we can add a clause in the Order Form to capture that option if you expect to use Dedicated.

2) Pen-test windows and creds: Our standard approach is a 30-day notice for full production tests; for lower-impact staging-only tests we can accept a 7-day notice. We provide ephemeral staging credentials for agreed staging ranges. We'll include a concise blast-radius appendix in the Security Exhibit so both sides have the same expectations.

3) Evidence cadence & delivery: Proposed onboarding cadence:
  - Week 0 (contract sign): SOC 2 attestation (most recent report), pen-test executive summary
  - Weeks 1-8: weekly evidence bundle (artifact snapshot + answering any clarifying Qs)
  - Delivery: secure Drive folder (link) + SFTP for higher-sensitivity artifacts — we prefer Drive for SOC artifacts and SFTP for raw logs if needed.

Next steps:
  - Please review MSA_Security_Exhibit_DRAFT.docx and add redlines / comments.
  - Can we schedule a 30-min legal + security sync on Wed 2026-09-02 at 10:00 AM PT? I can loop in our security ops lead Markus to cover staging/access.

I'll also flag our Legal team to prepare a narrow 'evidence request' SLA so we can meet your 48-hour turnaround ask where feasible.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Legal & Compliance, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: MSA_Security_Exhibit_DRAFT.docx (word)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Ross <avery.ross@pulselabs.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / audit scope questions — SOC 2 boundary + pen test cadence

Quick technical note from the runtime/ops side:

- Staging access: we will provide ephemeral, least-privilege staging tokens scoped to a customer-specific sandbox. Tokens are time-limited and rotated per test.
- Blast radius appendix should explicitly exclude cross-tenant data access and production PII exports. Pen tests that require tenant-level access will need a separate scoped agreement.
- Logs: we can provide 7 days of tokenized request logs via SFTP for triage; if Pulselabs needs a longer historic slice we can discuss retention exports (there may be cost impacts).

I'll prepare a short appendix describing the staging ACLs and attach here in the consolidated playbook before the 09/02 call.

— Markus
Principal Engineering Manager, Runtime
markus_klein@redwoodinference.com

From: Jessica Donahue <jessica.donahue@pulselabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Ross <avery.ross@pulselabs.com>, PulseLabs Security Team <security@pulselabs.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: PulseLabs redlines + a few operational confirmations

Kimberly / Markus,

Thanks for the proposed cadence and the draft exhibit — we've reviewed and our legal/security partners have three requested redlines and two operational asks: 

Redlines (summary):
1) Limit evidence requests to the in-scope services and sample sets not to exceed 8 weeks of full export without additional compensation.
2) Require 30-day notice for any production-impacting pen test; accept 7-day notice for staging-only tests.
3) Add a non-disclosure sentence that aggregated SOC2 findings may not be posted to public repos and require joint redaction of tenant identifiers in any shared artifact.

Operational asks:
- Confirm that Redwood will provide ephemeral staging creds and the ACL appendix Markus mentioned (yes/no).
- We need a 48-hour SLA for acknowlegement of formal evidence requests and an initial triage response within 5 business days for high-priority items.

I've attached our annotated redlines (Pulselabs_Redlines_Annotated.docx). We are prepared to countersign the Order Form quickly once the redlines are reconciled. We also pasted a short DocuSign link for the order form to speed execution.

Can you confirm on the staging creds and the 48-hour acknowledgement SLA? Also please confirm a short call today or tomorrow if any of the redlines are not acceptable.

Thanks,
Jessica Donahue
Counsel, PulseLabs
jessica.donahue@pulselabs.com

Attachment: Pulselabs_Redlines_Annotated.docx (word)
Link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/PLB-3491-orderform

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jessica Donahue <jessica.donahue@pulselabs.com>, Avery Ross <avery.ross@pulselabs.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PulseLabs redlines + a few operational confirmations

Jessica — thank you for the clear redline summary and the annotated doc. We reviewed internally and can agree to the redlines with the following mutual-action items captured below; I will upload the final Security Exhibit and the ACL appendix to the shared drive by EOD tomorrow.

Agreed redline resolutions / action items:
- Evidence limits: We'll codify the 8-week initial sample-set cap in the Security Exhibit; additional exports beyond that will be handled via a scoped change order (we'll add language to the Order Form).
- Pen-test notice: Accept 30-day notice for production-impacting tests, 7-day for staging-only. We'll include explicit blast-radius definitions.
- Tenant identifiers: We will redact tenant-level PII in shared artifacts and include a joint redaction step prior to any external distribution.

Operational SLAs and owners:
- Staging creds: Confirmed — we will provide ephemeral staging creds scoped per test (Markus will produce the ACL appendix).
- Evidence request SLA: Redwood will acknowledge formal evidence requests within 48 hours and provide an initial triage/update within 5 business days for high-priority items.
- Owners:
   - Redwood legal: Kimberly (contract redlines)
   - Redwood security ops: Markus (staging ACLs, evidence bundle packaging)
   - PulseLabs: Jessica (redlines), Avery (procurement cadence)

Timeline:
- EOD 2026-09-02: Security Exhibit (final) + ACL appendix uploaded to shared Drive
- 2026-09-03: Final legal touchpoint (15–30 min) to sign off redlines
- 2026-09-07: Target execution of MSA + Order Form (DocuSign)

Links / delivery:
- Shared Drive (read-only link will be provided): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPulselabsArtifacts
- If you prefer SFTP for logs, Markus will send SFTP onboarding details after the exhibit is final.

If that timeline looks good, please confirm and we'll route the final docs for signature.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Legal & Compliance, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: MSA_Security_ExHIBIT_FINAL.pdf (pdf)
